chunks: My father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan narrated to me from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb and al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, all from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

When you enter the city, perform ritual bath before entering it or when you intend to enter it. Then go to the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him) and send greetings upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). Then stand at the forward pillar on the right side of the grave, at the head of the grave, facing the Qiblah, with your left shoulder toward the grave and your right shoulder toward the pulpit, for this is the location of the head of the Prophet (peace be upon him).

And say: I testify that there is no god but Allah, alone, without partner, and I testify that Muḥammad is His slave and Messenger. And I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah and that you are Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh. And I testify that you conveyed the messages of your Lord, advised your nation, strove in the way of Allah, and worshipped Allah until certainty came to you, with wisdom and good counsel, and fulfilled what was upon you of the truth, and that you were kind to the believers and harsh to the disbelievers. So Allah granted you the highest honor of the honored.

Praise be to Allah who saved us through you from polytheism and misguidance. O Allah, make Your blessings, and the blessings of Your near angels, Your righteous servants, Your sent prophets, the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, and whoever glorified the Lord of the Worlds from the first and the last, upon Muḥammad, Your slave, Your Messenger, Your Prophet, Your Trustee, Your Confidant [Your Noble One], Your Beloved, Your Chosen One, Your Purity, Your Special One, and Your Best of Creation.
O Allah, grant him the Rank and the Proximity in Paradise, and raise him to a Praised Position which the first and the last will envy.

O Allah, You said: 'And had they, when they were unjust to themselves, come to You and asked forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Oft-returning, Most Merciful.' And I have come to Your Prophet, seeking forgiveness, repentant from my sins. And I turn to You through Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy, Muḥammad (peace be upon him).
O Muḥammad, I turn to Allah, my Lord and your Lord, through you, so that He forgives my sins.

And if you have a request, place the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him) behind your shoulder, face the Qiblah, raise your hands, and ask for your request, for you are more likely to have it granted, if Allah wills.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended ritual and supplication for visiting the Prophet's grave according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* details the specific etiquette for visiting the Prophet’s grave, emphasizing ritual purity and a precise physical orientation at the head of the tomb to facilitate direct supplication. It highlights the Shia concept of *tawassul* (seeking intercession), where the believer addresses the Prophet directly to convey their needs to God, grounded in the Quranic verse about the people of Noah seeking forgiveness through the Prophet. The text also underscores the Prophet’s role as a merciful intercessor who has fulfilled his divine trust, linking physical visitation with spiritual repentance and personal petition.
